wpa_supplicant: mesh: check kernel STA entry before adding In some cases, mesh beacons / probe resps may get queued up in the supplicant event queue. If supplicant processes back to back new peer candidate messages from the same peer, it may add the same peer to kernel multiple times. This creates a number of issues, including slow authentiction due to reiniting the state machine each time supplicant gets a new peer event. This CL checks, when supplicant already has a STA entry, if kernel also has the corresponding entry. If yes, then drop the new peer event and return. Also adding more logging information around mesh authentication and mpm processes. BUG=b:31555246 TEST=manually on 2 gales. Run child groobe test for 100 times and see the change triggers 43 times on root and 1 time on child. Observe 1 groobe test run containing Confirm mismatch message (it could still happen but not due to duplicate new peer events). Change-Id: Ib26c7d96ec8ee8de80746f8e2bf8d7c5ac056b0f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/387189 Commit-Ready: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org> Tested-by: Julan Hsu <julanhsu@google.com> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>
